name: Solidity
typeSystem: Static, strong, with contract-oriented types (address, mapping, fixed-size integers of many widths) but no generics and, until custom errors and user-defined value types were added, fairly limited abstraction facilities; values default to zero rather than null.
runtime: Compiled to EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine) bytecode, executed by every node on an EVM-compatible blockchain; gas costs meter every operation and storage access.

runtimes.name: EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine)
runtimes.role: Stack-based virtual machine run by every EVM-compatible chain node; each opcode consumes metered 'gas'.

compilers.name: solc
compilers.role: The reference Solidity compiler, emitting EVM bytecode.

concurrencyModel: EVM execution is synchronous within a transaction, but external calls create nested call frames and can re-enter a caller before it finishes. Transaction state changes are atomic on success or revert; client-level parallelism may execute independent transactions concurrently.
